description: He wears a long opaque plum noble coat with broad gold woven edging and decorative circular clasps over a cream floor-length undertunic. A plum shoulder cloak hangs at the sides, secured by round gold brooches. A broad patterned belt with a rectangular ornate buckle defines the waist. Cream cuffs and hem carry narrow dark-and-gold borders; dark brown leather boots are fully visible. No armor, weapon or headgear.
